meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: What data Yaiwell processes, why, who we share it with and how to exercise your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Yaiwell connects clients with beauty, wellness and sport professionals and venues. Here we explain, with no small print, what data of yours we process and why.

sections.heading: Who is responsible for your data
paragraphs: Yaiwell runs the yaiwell.app platform and is the controller of the data described on this page. For any question about your data, write to us at {email}.

sections.heading: What data we process
items: Account data: name, email, language and, if you provide it or it comes from your Google account, your photo.
Booking data: service, venue, date and time, amount paid and any notes you write for the professional.
Payment data: processed by Stripe. We never see or store your full card number.
If you are a business: trading name, tax ID, address, description, photos, opening hours, services and the payout account you set up in Stripe.
Location: if you allow it in your browser, we use it on the spot to show you nearby venues. We do not store it.
Technical data: error logs to keep the service running, without your card details.

sections.heading: What we use it for
items: Providing the service: creating your account, managing your bookings and payments and sending you notices about them (confirmation, cancellation, reminder, refunds). Legal basis: performance of the contract you accept when you sign up.
Letting you review a service you have received and showing those reviews. Legal basis: performance of the contract.
Protecting the platform, preventing fraud and fixing errors. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in keeping the service secure.
Meeting legal obligations, for example tax and accounting. Legal basis: legal obligation.
paragraphs: We do not send you advertising without your consent and we do not sell your data.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
items: The venue or professional you book with receives your name, the service, the date and time and your notes. We do not give them your email.

Providers that help us run the service, always on our behalf: Clerk (accounts and sign-in), Google (if you choose to sign in with Google), Stripe (payments), Supabase (database and files), Vercel (website hosting), Resend (sending emails), Sentry (error logging), Mapbox (address search) and OpenStreetMap (map images).
paragraphs: Some of these providers are outside the European Economic Area, for example in the United States. In that case the transfer relies on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: For as long as you keep your account. If you delete it, we erase or anonymise your data, except what the law requires us to keep, such as payment and billing records for the periods set by tax and commercial law.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We only use strictly necessary technical cookies: those for your session (Clerk) and those Stripe uses during payment to prevent fraud. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies. Maps load images from OpenStreetMap's servers, which receive your IP address in order to send them.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask us to access, correct or delete your data, to object to or restrict its processing, or to receive it in a portable format. Write to us at {email} from your account's email address. If you think we have not handled your request properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change this policy, we will publish the new version on this page with its update date. If the change is significant, we will let you know by email.

meta.title: Terms and conditions
meta.description: Yaiwell's terms of use for clients and businesses: bookings, payments, cancellations, reviews and commissions.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Yaiwell, whether you book services or offer them. By creating an account you accept them. We have written them to be easy to understand; if anything is unclear, write to us at {email}.

sections.heading: What Yaiwell is
paragraphs: Yaiwell is a platform that connects clients with beauty, wellness and sport venues and professionals so they can book and pay for their services. The service is always provided by the venue or professional; Yaiwell acts as an intermediary and handles the booking and the payment.

sections.heading: Your account
items: To book or offer services you need an account with genuine details and an email address that belongs to you.
You are responsible for what is done with your account. If you think someone has accessed it, let us know.
You can ask us to delete it at any time by writing to {email}.

sections.heading: How a booking works
items: The price you see is the final price the venue sets for that service.
When you choose a time slot, we hold it for 30 minutes so you can complete payment. If you do not pay within that time, the slot becomes available again.
The booking is confirmed once payment is complete. We send you the confirmation by email.
We only offer time slots that start at least 30 minutes after the moment of booking.
When you book, the contract for the service is formed between you and the venue or professional.

sections.heading: Payments
paragraphs: Payment is made online when you book, using the methods offered by Stripe, our payment provider. Yaiwell collects the amount on behalf of the venue and transfers it to them after deducting its commission. We do not store your full card details.

sections.heading: Cancellations and refunds
items: If you have made a booking, you can cancel it free of charge up to 2 hours before the service starts by writing to us at {email}. We refund 100% of the amount.
Last-minute bookings, those starting less than 2 hours after they are made, are paid on the spot and cannot be cancelled or refunded. We let you know before you pay.
If you do not turn up for an appointment, there is no refund.
The venue can cancel a booking up to 2 hours before it starts. In that case we refund you 100% automatically and let you know by email.
If the venue cannot see you for any other reason, we also refund you 100%: just write to us.
If your payment arrives when the time slot is no longer available, there is no booking and we refund you 100% automatically.
Refunds go back to the same payment method. Depending on your bank, they may take 5 to 10 days to appear.

sections.heading: Discounted time slots
paragraphs: A venue can offer a time slot that has become free at a discount. The reference price is always its usual price, and the discount applies to whoever books that slot, wherever they come from. These bookings follow the same advance-notice and cancellation rules as any other.

sections.heading: Reviews
items: You can only review a service you have booked and that the venue has marked as completed, within the following 30 days.
Your review must be honest and about your own experience. Insults, other people's personal data and illegal or promotional content are not allowed.
We may remove reviews that break these rules. The venue can reply publicly.
A published review still counts even if the booking is refunded later.

sections.heading: If you offer services
items: We review every business by hand before publishing it. The details you give us (name, tax ID, address, services, prices, opening hours and photos) must be accurate and up to date.
You undertake to honour confirmed bookings at the published time and price. You can only cancel up to 2 hours before; the client receives a full refund.
Yaiwell charges a commission on each booking, according to your plan, calculated on what the client pays (including any discount). Current rates are shown on the page for professionals.
You receive payouts through your Stripe account, which you must set up and keep active.
You are responsible for providing the service and for your tax and professional obligations.
We may suspend or remove a business that breaches these terms or that builds up justified cancellations or complaints.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Do not use Yaiwell for anything illegal, to impersonate other people, to make fake bookings or to interfere with how the platform works. We may suspend accounts that do so.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: We do everything we can to keep the platform working well, but the service is provided by the venue or professional, who is responsible for its quality. If you have a problem with an appointment, write to us and we will help you sort it out. Nothing in these terms limits the rights the law gives you as a consumer.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: If we change them, we will publish the new version on this page with its date. If the change is significant, we will let you know by email before it takes effect. Bookings already made are governed by the terms in force when you made them.

sections.heading: Governing law and complaints
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Spanish law. If you have a complaint, write to us first at {email} and we will deal with it. If you are a consumer, you can also turn to consumer protection bodies or to the courts where you live.

meta.title: Cookie policy
meta.description: Which cookies Yaiwell uses: only strictly necessary technical ones, with no analytics or advertising.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: Cookies are small files that a website stores in your browser. At Yaiwell we only use the ones strictly necessary for the website to work, so we do not ask for your consent with a banner.

sections.heading: Cookies we use
items: Session (Clerk): they keep you signed in and protect your account. Without them you could not sign in.
Payment (Stripe): only on the payment page, to prevent card fraud.
Preferences: they remember your language, whether you prefer the light or dark theme and, if you have a business, whether you are viewing the website as a client or as a professional.

sections.heading: Cookies we do not use
paragraphs: We do not use analytics, advertising or social media cookies, and we do not share information about your browsing with advertisers.

sections.heading: Maps
paragraphs: Maps load images from OpenStreetMap's servers. They do not set cookies, but those servers receive your IP address in order to send you the images.

sections.heading: How to manage them
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block the session or payment cookies, you will not be able to sign in or book. For more details on how we handle your data, see the privacy policy.
